groups.anti_bias: attack-vector: mechanics/correctness versus fidelity/governance versus ownership/reference integrity

agents.angle: mechanics and correctness of hashes, schemas, gates and executable validation
agents.initial_prompt: Read exactly the eight source_bindings and eleven authority_bindings. Attack mechanics/correctness only: stale digests, malformed schema, impossible gates, validation commands that cannot prove the obligation, and proposal/appender incompatibility. Do not edit or search outside the bound corpus. Return candidate findings with exact file quotations, severity and one-line fix; defend zero findings per target.

agents.angle: fidelity and governance of claims, authority, selection and readiness
agents.initial_prompt: Read exactly the eight source_bindings and eleven authority_bindings. Attack fidelity/governance only: unsupported PASS or selection claims, owner authority inflation, contradictions with DomainSpec/WORK-PACK/review findings, and hidden scope expansion. Do not edit or search outside the bound corpus. Return candidate findings with exact file quotations, severity and one-line fix; defend zero findings per target.

agents.angle: ownership and reference integrity across paths, artifacts and lifecycle handoffs
agents.initial_prompt: Read exactly the eight source_bindings and eleven authority_bindings. Attack ownership/reference integrity only: dangling or double-owned artifacts, missing synchronization, write-scope leaks, wrong lifecycle owner, and handoffs that cannot be consumed. Do not edit or search outside the bound corpus. Return candidate findings with exact file quotations, severity and one-line fix; defend zero findings per target.
